stories.title: New Clearfield mural the work of high school artist, Sterling Scholar
stories.summary: There's a mural on the border of Clearfield and Clinton, inside the tunnel on 800 North, that began as part of an art student's Sterling Scholar application.

stories.title: Stockpile of unstable and dangerous lead azide scheduled for detonation in Iowa
stories.summary: The U.S. Army plans to detonate the nation's entire stockpile of lead azide Wednesday morning in Iowa after warning the degrading chemicals could explode at any time.

stories.title: Why the holidays are hard for kids: 5 ways to prevent inevitable meltdowns
stories.summary: The holidays are full of moments we look forward to all year, and that's always when your child chooses to completely fall apart. Ginger Healy shared why the holidays can be hard on some kids and how we can help them through it.

stories.title: Federal jury finds Idaho man guilty of COVID-19 fraud, laundering over $195K in relief funding
stories.summary: Christopher Curtis of Pocatello, Idaho, was found guilty by a federal jury on Nov. 19 of fraud and money-laundering charges related to COVID-19 pandemic-relief funds.

stories.title: Consumer confidence soars with elections in the rearview mirror and gas prices in retreat
stories.summary: Americans' confidence in the economy jumped this month as gas prices continued their steady decline and election-related uncertainty ended.

stories.title: How to spot holiday shopping and charity scams
stories.summary: Shopping scams were the most commonly reported scams that started on social media last year. AARP's fraud prevention director explains how to check out an unfamiliar seller or charity and what to do if you've already sent money.

stories.title: After back-to-back floods, one neighbor's nonprofit helps Hurricane rebuild
stories.summary: La Verkin resident Cherie Santiago mobilized local businesses and volunteers to raise over $220,000 in relief funds after back-to-back floods struck Hurricane.

stories.title: An unclassified CIA system was breached in a cyberattack, AP source says
stories.summary: An unclassified CIA system was breached in a cyberattack, according to a person familiar with the incident who spoke to The Associated Press on condition of anonymity.

stories.title: The latest College Football Playoff rankings are out and Utah and BYU maintain playoff positioning
stories.summary: In less than four minutes of time, Utah football overwhelmed TCU. And the quick barrage of points likely guaranteed Utah a spot in the College Football Playoff.

stories.title: Cache County School District receives $990K grant to improve student literacy
stories.summary: A Cache Valley school district is getting nearly a million dollars from Intermountain Health to help more students become successful readers.

stories.title: Curtis questions Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: Utah Sen. John Curtis said he agreed with tech CEO Jensen Huang's initial decision to step down from Nvidia and appeared skeptical about Huang's sudden reinstatement this week.

stories.title: U2's new album is about 'defiant joy.' They'll tour it in North America next summer
stories.summary: Fresh off the release of their first album of new songs in nine years, the spirited "Carnaval de Luz," Irish rockers U2 have announced a North American tour.
